Emperor’s Lounge — Taj Mansingh, New Delhi (2018).

Design updates for the Taj’s circular lounge — its marble centre-fountain, domed chhatri and panoramic garden windows kept and continued, not competed with. A pietra-dura parapet of Mughal stone-inlay; a brass jaali band across the windows; gold-and-ceramic birds along the rail; a brass-and-mahogany shelf for the teapots of the world.

Interior — Anirudh Kapoor. A·02
